item.title: Matka Studios | YouTube
item.description: Where my love for game development and video essays meets. At Matka Studios, I write, direct, and edit deep dives exploring game design, creative experiments, and the raw reality of building an indie studio from scratch.

item.title: Cronic Digital | Marketing
item.description: Over five years working with Cronic Digital, I directed and produced commercial campaigns, institutional films, and branded content. It was also where I started integrating AI tools directly into our production and post-production pipeline to speed up concepts and visual experiments.

item.title: Jimmy Kim TV | YouTube
item.description: My editing work for Jimmy Kim TV throughout 2025. Across 27 travel and street food videos, the goal was always dialing in the comedic timing and rhythm so the episodes felt effortless and genuinely fun to watch. Together, the series pulled in over 4.5 million views.

item.title: La Mondo En Ekvilibro | Marketing
item.description: A much more atmospheric, conceptual piece created for La Mondo en Ekvilibro. We wanted to explore nature, technology, and environmental balance by layering motion design, archive footage, and generative visuals into a cinematic mood piece.

item.title: Nice N Raw | YouTube
item.description: A truly hands-on YouTube project where I wore almost every hat. For Nice N Raw, I handled camera operation, on-set direction, and the entire editing pipeline in Premiere and After Effects, working to give the channel a sharp, distinctive visual rhythm from shoot to final cut.

item.title: Art Direction | Design
item.description: A look into the graphic design side of my work. These are brand identities and visual systems I built for various clients, focused on art direction, custom assets, and making sure the look holds up across digital platforms and print.

item.title: Lixo Carmesim | Stop Motion
item.description: A departure from my everyday commercial work, but easily one of the most rewarding grinds. On this stop-motion short, I spent about three months cleaning up puppet rigs frame by frame in Photoshop and After Effects, touching more than 4,000 individual frames to bring the animation to life.
